audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers handed Sion levels 2 and 3 while the content whys for those exact rows describe Shen dictating every trade — the chart argued against its own explanations.
audit.why: The packet chart gives Shen rows 2 through 6, the mirror audit flipped rows 2, 3 and first item to Shen and two-plus items to Skill, and the 49.31% win rate over 2815 games supports a lane you survive rather than win.
audit.corrected: Flipped four rows as matched full/content pairs: Level 2, Level 3 and First item to Shen, 2+ items to Skill. Levels 4-5 and Level 6 stay Skill and Level 1 stays Skill — the mirror did not touch them and I will not introduce a disagreement it would have to fix.

audit.whatIsWrong: The first-item spike was written as an EVEN pivot where your HP pool makes you hard to kill.
audit.why: Twilight Assault deals damage based on the target's max health. Stacking health into Shen partially feeds his Q, so Heartsteel is not the clean pivot the page claims.
audit.corrected: Rewrote whys[5] and spikes[2].text around the max-health scaling and Ki Barrier's shield refreshing whenever he affects a champion.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spirit's Refuge is treated as a general damage-block that makes trading into him pointless.
audit.why: Riot's text is specific: attacks that would hit Shen or his allies near the spirit blade are blocked. Attacks — not abilities. Decimating Smash and Roar of the Slayer land through the zone untouched, which is the single most useful thing a Sion can know here.
audit.corrected: Stated it in spikes[0].text and wants.you[1], with Spirit's Refuge's 16s and Shadow Dash's 18s rank-1 cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing anywhere says Stand United is interruptible.
audit.why: The kit carries the channel flag and Shen's text is a teleport after a delay — CC on Shen during that channel stops the save. Your charged Q and Unstoppable Onslaught are both hard CC.
audit.corrected: Added to late, alongside Stand United's 200-second rank-1 cooldown.

edits.before: Shen gets W (Spirit's Refuge) and his E-taunt online together — he can block your auto-based Q follow-up and taunt you into his Q on demand, so trades are his to dictate.
edits.after: Spirit's Refuge and Shadow Dash arrive together — the blade blocks attacks, not abilities, so your autos die inside it while Q and E still land. His dash is 18s at rank 1.

edits.before: First item is the EVEN pivot: Heartsteel compounds your HP pool and your W-shield scales with it, making you genuinely hard to kill in the sustained brawl Shen prefers — neither player has a clean edge.
edits.after: Heartsteel compounds your HP pool, but Twilight Assault damages off your max health and Ki Barrier re-shields him every time he touches a champion — he still edges the sustained brawl he prefers here.

edits.before: Both players spike here; your Heartsteel begins compounding HP and your W-shield value rises, making you genuinely hard to kill in the sustained trade Shen wants.
edits.after: Heartsteel compounds your HP and your shield value rises, but Twilight Assault scales off your max health — raw health partly feeds his Q, so pair it with resistances.

edits.before: At 2+ items your zombie Passive guarantees fight contribution even if Shen out-trades you, and your raw bulk in a 5v5 brawl outlasts his taunt-peel utility — the lane deficit no longer translates to a late-game loss.
edits.after: At 2+ items your zombie Passive guarantees fight contribution even if Shen out-trades you, and your raw bulk in a 5v5 brawl matches his taunt-peel utility — neither side closes the game alone from here.

edits.before: Detonate W-shield during his taunt dash to eat the auto-block window he expects to have
edits.after: Trade with Q and E inside Spirit's Refuge — it stops attacks, never your abilities

edits.before: Once both players have Heartsteel and a second item, the true EVEN resolution kicks in: your W-shield value scales with your enormous HP pool, your E armor-shred reduces Shen's tankiness in the brawl, and your Passive zombie guarantees fight contribution whether or not you die first. Shen is not a damage threat at full build — he is a CC platform for his team. In a pure side-by-side brawl your bulk and zombie passive outlast his taunt-trade pattern. The danger here is not the Shen lane — it is him abandoning the lane and winning fights globally with Stand United while you are split from your team. Force your ult engage when his R is on cooldown, so he cannot bail a teammate during your all-in window.
edits.after: Once both players have Heartsteel and a second item the lane settles: your shield scales with your HP pool, your E armour-shred thins him out, and your Passive guarantees contribution whether or not you die first. Shen is not a damage threat at full build — but Twilight Assault still bites off your max health, so bulk alone does not make you immune to him. The danger is him abandoning the lane and winning fights globally with Stand United, which is 200 seconds at rank 1 and a channel: land your charged Q or Unstoppable Onslaught on him while it is going up and the save never arrives.
